# How to make AI UGC ads with Claude Code (open-source Arcads alternative)

**Turn a product photo into a phone-real UGC ad: an AI creator holds your real product, the label stays exact and the script stays FTC-safe.**

**Typical cost** with `ai-ugc-ad-video`: ~$1.20–6 per 15 s ad incl. retakes (estimate). Models are billed at provider price, and the agent shows an estimate before you pay. **Free, no key:** `product-video-hooks`, `video-script`, `caption-styles`, `social-overlays`.

**Short answer:** start with [`ai-ugc-ad-video`](../../ai-ugc-ad-video/README.md): cast the AI creator, write the phone-real script, generate on Seedance 2.5 or Kling 4, reject pass. The other 6 skills below add the steps around it. Ask your agent for the result in your own words; it asks the few choices that matter before anything is paid for and hands back the files.

```bash
# Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other agents
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill ai-ugc-ad-video --skill product-video-hooks --skill video-script --skill varg-product-lock --skill caption-styles --skill social-overlays --skill ai-ad-compliance-check
```

Then ask your agent in plain words, for example: *"Make a 20-second UGC ad for my vitamin C serum from this photo: ./serum.jpg. A woman in her 30s at a bathroom mirror, 9:16 for Meta Reels. Quote credits before you generate."*

## FAQ

### Do AI UGC ads work?

For cold traffic and finding the winning angle, yes. The skill cites one operator's $100K test (220 videos): human UGC had the higher CTR and AI the higher ROAS, because AI made more variants cheaply. It is weak for high-ticket offers and warm audiences.

### Are AI UGC ads legal?

The AI creator may demo the product and state facts, but never give a first-person testimonial or result ("I used it for two weeks..."): the FTC bans fake testimonials, AI ones included, and New York requires a synthetic-performer disclosure. ai-ad-compliance-check returns the rule and a rewrite for each line. Not legal advice.

### Can I use AI UGC on TikTok Shop?

Not as the presenter. TikTok Shop rules ban an AI voice standing in for the presenter, so the skill stops and hands over to tiktok-shop-video, which uses AI only for b-roll under a real person.

### Why does my AI UGC look fake?

Usually waxy skin, perfect light and an unreadable label. The skill writes real skin details (pores, flyaway hairs), prompts phone flaws (handheld tremor, autofocus hunts, phone-mic audio), uses a straight-on product photo with a readable label, and rejects clips whose face, label or hand count drift.

### Seedance 2.5 or Kling 4 for AI UGC?

Seedance 2.5 looks the most real but takes about 3 attempts per keeper (reported); Kling 4 is cheaper and often right first time, and Kling 4 Flash is for drafts. The skill prices the whole batch with estimate_cost first.

### How do I keep the same face and product in every clip?

Make one creator still and an identity sheet, pass the same image plus the product photo on every shot, and never switch models between shots of one creator. varg-product-lock adds a lock sheet and a drift check for the product.
